neighbours.label: the word ' alternating' and similar mid-phrase technical tokens (alternating current)
fire: Food can be treated with gamma irradiation, alternating current, or ultrasound.
The motor runs on alternating current supplied by the grid.
The pattern uses alternating rows of red and white bricks.
Patients were given alternating doses of the two drugs.
The test applied an alternating magnetic field to the sample.
The poem has alternating lines of six and eight syllables.
The coach scheduled alternating days of running and rest.
Engineers measured the alternating voltage across the coil.
quiet: Food can be treated with gamma irradiation, direct heat, or ultrasound.
The motor runs on direct current supplied by the battery.
The pattern uses straight rows of red and white bricks.
Patients were given equal doses of the two drugs.
The test applied a constant magnetic field to the sample.
The poem has regular lines of six and eight syllables.
The coach scheduled separate days of running and rest.
Engineers measured the output voltage across the coil.
